info.description: Sequential Atlas verification. Generates two users and one campground per run; removes only run bookings. Run using npm run verify:demo from backend for durable recovery and sanitized timing evidence. No cloud publication.

pm.test('Twenty run bookings present', () => { const ids = ['BOOKING_ID','B_BOOKING_ID','ADMIN_BOOKING_ID', ...Array.from({length:17}, (_,i) => 'TIMING_'+i)].map(k => pm.collectionVariables.get(k)); pm.expect(body.data.filter(b => ids.includes(b.id))).to.have.lengthOf(20); });
